result.brief: 提出查询感知流式潜空间推理框架，用持久 think token 跨片段聚合长视频证据，在固定嵌入维度下提升长视频检索与视频问答表征质量。
result.reason: Post-training framework producing fixed-size long-video embeddings via persistent think tokens and streaming latent aggregation; a video representation learning contribution, not merely using an encoder as baseline.
